name: Retry storm: a flaky dependency amplifies its own load
description: Offered load is 18/s against 10 workers at 0.5 s each (90% utilisation), and the dependency fails 30% of calls. Failures and throttled calls are retried immediately, so the effective load exceeds capacity and the system overloads: see retry.RetryAmplification (about 2.6) and pool.NumberThrottled. Jittered backoff only delays this (it does not fix a capacity shortfall); raising concurrency to 16 cuts amplification to about 1.7.
